snippet.title: Militsioner — Playtest Last Call Trailer
snippet.description:
Sign up for playtest on Steam: https://s.team/a/1373530

The playtest is live and available for anyone, but it ends September 18.

Every move you make is being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this kafkaesque immersive sim.
